annotations.title: List covered metros, chains and malls

description: Use this to check whether Aisles covers a place, chain or mall before answering, or when the user asks where Aisles works. Lists the 192 metro areas with published listings, with their slugs, the chains Aisles lists in each and the specific shopping malls whose stores are covered (with each mall's town). A metro being covered does not mean every store in it is.

filter.description: Optional: words a metro, its state, a chain or a mall must contain, e.g. "TX", "Kroger", "Roosevelt Field". Leave it out for every covered metro.
